name_zh: 穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼/2030愿景：后石油转型治理与技术主权
name_en: Mohammed bin Salman/Vision 2030: Post-Oil Transition Governance & Tech Sovereignty
description_zh: 穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼 (1985-) 2015 年任王储，2016 启动《2030 愿景》：三大支柱——活力社会(旅游/文化/娱乐/体育)、繁荣经济(PIF 主权基金 7 万亿+、NEOM/红海/吉达新城、绿色氢能/半导体/生物技术)、雄心政府(数字化/透明化/女性劳动参与率 30%+)。核心张力：威权现代化 vs 社会保守主义、外资依赖 vs 技术主权、区域霸权 vs 国际孤立风险 (卡舒吉案/也门战争)。体现 M169 后石油转型治理——主权基金再投资锚定知识经济，以及 M158 通才整合——跨能源/科技/金融/城市规划/社会工程的全谱系国家转型工程。
description_en: Mohammed bin Salman (1985-) Crown Prince 2015, launched Vision 2030 2016: three pillars—vibrant society (tourism/culture/entertainment/sports), thriving economy (PIF SWF $7T+, NEOM/Red Sea/Jeddah new cities, green hydrogen/semiconductors/biotech), ambitious government (digitalization/transparency/female labor participation 30%+). Core tensions: authoritarian modernization vs social conservatism, foreign capital dependency vs tech sovereignty, regional hegemony vs international isolation risk (Khashoggi/Yemen war). Exemplifies M169 Post-Oil Transition Governance—SWF reinvestment anchoring knowledge economy, and M158 Polymath Integration—full-spectrum national transformation engineering across energy/tech/finance/urban planning/social engineering.
reason_zh: MBS 试图在单代人内完成"从石油租金国家到知识经济强国"的跨越，这是 M169 的极限压力测试：PIF 作为国家风投，NEOM 作为绿地实验区，社会开放作为人才磁场。区隔于 M168(缓解)、M170(稳定)，核心在于"单代人跨越式转型+主权基金充当国家风投+绿地新城实验"。
reason_en: MBS attempts single-generation leap from 'oil rentier state to knowledge economy powerhouse', M169's extreme stress test: PIF as national VC, NEOM as greenfield lab, social opening as talent magnet. Distinct from M168 (mitigation) and M170 (stability), core: 'single-generational leapfrog transition + SWF as national venture capital + greenfield new city experiment'.
steps_zh: PIF 国家风投化：资产从 $1500 亿增至 $7 万亿+，投资 Uber/软银/卢西德/电子游戏/绿色氢能
NEOM 绿地实验区：$5000 亿零碳城市，The Line 线性城市/氢能出口/生物技术/旅游
社会契约重写：女性驾驶/娱乐开放/劳动法改革/反腐(利兹酒店) 重塑精英契约
数字政府与透明化：Absher/App 服务/开放数据/采购透明化/绩效考核 KPI
区域外交重构：海湾和解/以色列关系正常化探索/也门停火/红海安全联盟
steps_en: PIF as national VC: assets from $150B to $7T+, investing in Uber/SoftBank/Lucid/gaming/green hydrogen
NEOM greenfield lab: $500B zero-carbon city, The Line linear city/hydrogen export/biotech/tourism
Social contract rewrite: women driving/entertainment opening/labor law reform/anti-corruption (Ritz-Carlton) reshaping elite pact
Digital government & transparency: Absher app services/open data/procurement transparency/KPI performance mgmt
Regional diplomacy restructuring: Gulf reconciliation/Israel normalization exploration/Yemen ceasefire/Red Sea security alliance
expected_zh: 单代人内完成后石油转型，实现"石油租金->主权基金->知识经济->技术主权"闭环，或成或败，为资源型国家提供极限案例。
expected_en: Single-generational post-oil transition achieving 'oil rent->SWF->knowledge economy->tech sovereignty' closed loop, success or failure provides extreme case for resource states.
case_zh: PIF 2023 资产 $7000 亿+；NEOM 2024 启动建设；女性劳动参与率 2017 20%→2023 35%；非石油收入占比 2016 38%→2023 50%+；但也门战争/卡舒吉案/人权争议持续。
case_en: PIF 2023 assets $700B+; NEOM 2024 construction started; female labor participation 2017 20%->2023 35%; non-oil revenue 2016 38%->2023 50%+; but Yemen war/Khashoggi/human rights controversies persist.
cross_cultural_impact: Vision 2030 benchmark for Gulf diversification; NEOM urban experiment; PIF global investment model
colonial_history: No direct colonial rule; British treaty relations 1915-1927
resource_curse_mitigation: PIF diversification; NEOM green hydrogen; non-oil revenue target 50% by 2030; ESG reporting
